profile_E2B.claim: Where the Bella-vs-Gemma direction separates the two voices across E2B layers, relative to the shuffled null and the global-attention layers.
profile_E2B.reader_check: Compare the solid line's crests against the dotted global-attention layers and against the null band.
profile_E2B.why_visual: The layer-wise shape (wave vs plateau) is the claim.

profile_E4B.claim: Where the Bella-vs-Gemma direction separates the two voices across E4B layers, relative to the shuffled null and the global-attention layers.
profile_E4B.reader_check: Compare the solid line's crests against the dotted global-attention layers and against the null band.
profile_E4B.why_visual: The layer-wise shape (wave vs plateau) is the claim.

adjacent_cosine.claim: The direction is one slowly rotating direction through the middle of the stack and rotates sharply at a few boundaries.
adjacent_cosine.reader_check: Read where the cosine dips toward zero.
adjacent_cosine.why_visual: Dips mark boundaries where the direction changes identity.

mean_projection.claim: How far the model's own replies sit from Bella along the direction at each layer, in residual-norm units.
mean_projection.reader_check: Compare the solid (Gemma) and dashed (Bella) series; their gap is the shift a steering coefficient must cover.
mean_projection.why_visual: The gap's size across layers sets the coefficient scale.

steering_E2B.claim: Whether scaling the Assistant direction down in E2B raises Bella-ness before refusal, crisis quality or fluency degrade.
steering_E2B.reader_check: Find coefficients where the top two panels move but the bottom three stay near the unsteered reference.
steering_E2B.why_visual: The window is a joint condition across six curves.

steering_E4B.claim: Whether scaling the Assistant direction down in E4B raises Bella-ness before refusal, crisis quality or fluency degrade.
steering_E4B.reader_check: Find coefficients where the top two panels move but the bottom three stay near the unsteered reference.
steering_E4B.why_visual: The window is a joint condition across six curves.

dose_response.claim: The intervention reaches the model: negative coefficients raise the probability of Bella's reply relative to Gemma's own.
dose_response.reader_check: Check that the lines rise monotonically as the coefficient goes negative.
expected: one line per model and layer
dose_response.why_visual: Monotonic dose response is the check that a null steering result is not an inert edit.

sae_reconstruction.claim: The direction is a smear over hundreds of SAE features, not one or a handful.
sae_reconstruction.reader_check: Read the k at which each curve crosses 50%, 80% and 95%.
sae_reconstruction.why_visual: The curve's slowness is the finding.
